part.text:
All failures in `test-regression1_cpp11` are due to missing downloaded test data (`json_test_data`), unrelated to the change. All enum/serialization-related tests pass.

## Summary

Fixed enum serialization in two headers:

- `include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp:428` — `to_json_fn::convert_enum` now tag-dispatches on `std::is_unsigned<underlying_type>`: unsigned enums construct via `external_constructor<value_t::number_unsigned>` (as `std::uint64_t`), signed enums via `value_t::number_integer` as before.
- `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp:5694` — same fix in the amalgamated header, implemented with tag-dispatch helpers (`construct_enum`) to remain C++11-compatible (the test suite targets `cxx_std_11`, so `if constexpr` was not used).

Verification:
- Standalone repro (large `uint64_t` enum `1<<63`): now serializes as `9223372036854775808`, `is_number_unsigned() == true`, full-range value round-trips correctly; signed/`uint8_t` enums unchanged.
- In-container test build: `test-udt_cpp11` (includes the issue's repro cases), `test-udt_macro_cpp11`, `test-serialization_cpp11`, `test-conversions_cpp11`, `test-meta_cpp11`, `test-type_traits_cpp11`, `test-constructor1/2_cpp11`, `test-regression2_cpp11` all pass.
